name: Whole-Combat Stage-A Response Surface Under Tactical Utility Doctrine
resourceTreatment: reuse the exact five mechanically distinct CP144 executable resource environments and the exact accepted 6,850 Stage-A scenario identities
smokePolicy: complete 6,850-scenario one-trial tactical-utility smoke before substantive execution
substantivePolicy: 500 deterministic trials per scenario under cp147_tactical_utility; aggregate per-scenario response surfaces without persisting raw per-turn rows
baseMaxTpDemandDefinition: sum all installed normal combat TP consumers at their normal maximum simultaneous demand: Energy Standard or normal K/M weapon use, Active-Low Sensor, full-strength ECM/ECCM, PDS readiness, Shield Hardener, maximum normal tactical Shield recharge, mainline Armor tactical regeneration, and one Damage-Control attempt; exclude every overload mode and zero-TP normal STL movement
tpLoadAnalysisPolicy: record base reactor TP, base maximum installed TP demand, mean actual TP allocated per side-turn, peak actual TP allocated per turn, allocated/max-demand fractions, and max-demand/reactor ratio
strategicParetoDefinition: determine combat-only Pareto eligibility at each TL before strategic/resource/robustness Pareto comparison; a combat-dominated system cannot become strategically viable solely because it is resource-efficient
roleResponsePolicy: report designated role response separately: Kinetic Armor Pressure, Energy Shield Pressure, GP Missile no-PDS core, Swarmer the three PDS-pressure strata; role reporting does not impose numerical equality or auto-promotion
analysisPolicy: broad multivariate response surfaces under accepted CP147 tactical utility, TP-load surfaces, role response, combat-gated strategic viability, counter/resource/TL sensitivity, pacing, and action-selection telemetry; no automatic tuning or promotion
